title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProcessingFunction
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingFunction. Represents the functionality of processing (pre-treating, treating, disposing of) waste. Subclass of saref:Function (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.22); saref:Function is SAREF Core, out of this candidate's scope. Base class for s4envi:WastePreTreatmentFunction, s4envi:WasteTreatmentFunction and s4envi:WasteDisposalFunction.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WasteProcessingFunction'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
